sandbox.title: Sandbox Security
sandbox.enabledDesc: When enabled, all AI execution is governed by file, command, and network security rules
sandbox.fileDesc: Manage file read/write permissions and allow/block lists
sandbox.commandDesc: Manage allow/ask/block lists for shell commands
sandbox.networkDesc: Manage network requests and domain lists

dataSafety.title: Data Safety
dataSafety.backupDesc: Automatically back up files before each conversational modification
dataSafety.deleteProtectionDesc: Deleted files go to the trash instead of being permanently removed
dataSafety.bulkThresholdDesc: Pause and ask for confirmation when deleting more files than this threshold
dataSafety.invalidThreshold: Threshold must be an integer between 1 and 10000

audit.title: Audit Center
audit.clearDesc: This deletes all security operation logs and cannot be undone.

events.command-safety_cwd-fallback: Working directory out of bounds, fell back: {{requested}}

commandDetail.title: Command Security
commandDetail.priorityNote: Priority: program blocklist (absolute, incl. child processes) > ask list > allow list > default approval

programBlacklist.title: Program blocklist
programBlacklist.desc: Programs that must never run (incl. child process detection); enter program names only, without paths or arguments

allow.title: Allow list
allow.desc: Runs directly without approval when matched (treated as trusted; does not match child processes)

ask.title: Ask list
ask.desc: Prompts for approval when matched (also effective in full-access mode); execution continues after approval

fileDetail.title: File Security
fileDetail.priorityNote: Priority: builtin sensitive paths (immutable, incl. app data) > user allowlist > user blocklist; reads and writes to blocklisted paths require approval (even in full access mode)

builtin.title: Built-in sensitive paths
builtin.desc: Preset sensitive config paths (SSH keys, cloud credentials, etc.); immutable — reads/writes require approval on hit

blocklist.title: User blocklist
blocklist.desc: Reads and writes to matched paths require approval; supports ~/-prefixed, absolute, or workspace-relative paths

allowlist.title: User allowlist
allowlist.desc: Writes to matched paths skip approval (takes precedence over blocklist, but cannot bypass builtin paths)

networkDetail.title: Network Safety
networkDetail.priorityNote: Priority: built-in exemptions (model APIs/localhost) > denylist > allowlist > offline mode > malicious domains; patterns support *.example.com wildcards.
networkDetail.blockAllNetworkDesc: All requests outside the allowlist and built-in exemptions will be denied
networkDetail.maliciousDesc: Block access to domains in the built-in malicious list

allowlist.title: Allowlist
allowlist.desc: Match allows (still allowed in offline mode)

builtin.title: Built-in malicious domains
builtin.desc: Code-built-in, updated with app versions, cannot be removed; not enforced when the switch above is off

networkDetail.boundaryNote: Coverage: main-process requests (model calls/MCP/skill market), renderer images and links, and command subprocesses honoring proxy env vars; deep bypasses such as raw sockets are out of scope.
